observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body labeled “EOS 600D” with a Canon lens marked “EFS 18-55mm”.
Photo 1 shows the camera from the back; the screen is off/black and the body controls are visible.
Photo 2 shows two different Canon lenses (one appears to be EFS 18-55mm; the other looks like a zoom lens with a different front ring/markings).
A bag/case is visible in the background, but its contents/condition aren’t clear.

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera and lenses, but do not prove UK origin, “very neat”, or sharp image output.
Photos show “Canon” branding and “EOS 600D” on the camera body (photo 0 and photo 1).

risks.risk: Wrong brand/model claim from seller text (Sony vs Canon) suggests possible mix-up or misleading listing.
risks.proof: Ask seller to confirm the exact model in writing and send a photo of the model name on the camera body plus the lens model(s) clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Canon EOS 600D with possible accessories uncertainty (worst-case: only what’s clearly shown).

risks.risk: Camera may not be fully functional (focus, shutter count/health, buttons, autofocus, sensor issues). Photos can’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: Request a short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a test photo preview on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume faults possible (worst-case: treat as needing service).

risks.risk: Lens condition/compatibility: one lens is clearly EFS 18-55mm, but the second lens in photo 2 is not clearly readable (could be different mount/condition).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of both lenses’ front and side labels (model/series) and a photo of the lens mount connection to the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as only the clearly identified EFS 18-55mm lens included; treat the second lens as unconfirmed.

risks.risk: Missing essentials: battery, charger, memory card, and straps are not clearly confirmed as included.
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo showing all included items (battery, charger, cables, memory card, strap, caps).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the camera body + clearly shown lens(es), with no guaranteed extras.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the camera’s “EOS 600D” label and the lens model text for BOTH lenses.
Send a short test video: power on, menu, autofocus lock, and a sample photo displayed on the screen.
Confirm what’s included: battery, charger, memory card, lens caps, and any other accessories (with a single ‘all items laid out’ photo).
Provide shutter count (or a photo from the camera menu showing shutter count if available).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 600D with an EFS 18-55mm lens, but the seller’s text conflicts (Sony vs Canon) and the photos don’t prove it’s working or that all accessories/lenses are included. Missing functional proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
